rules.msg: TLS anomaly - SNI is a bare IPv4 literal (non-RFC6066, suspicious client) [medium]

description.attack: TLS anomaly: SNI berupa IPv4 literal (melanggar RFC 6066) — klien mencurigakan tanpa perlu dekripsi.
description.impact: Indikator tooling/malware (klien sah selalu kirim hostname).
description.detects: SNI di ClientHello = IPv4 literal (cleartext, tanpa dekripsi).
